title: Procedures related to EAP methods used for primary authentication of an N5GC device

entities.name: EAP-based primary authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: Authentication procedure using EAP methods supporting mutual authentication (other than EAP-AKA') for N5GC devices, involving W-AGF, AMF, and AUSF.

entities.name: AUSF
entities.description: Authentication Server Function supporting authentication of N5GC device and acting as EAP server for at least one EAP method.

entities.name: N5GC device
entities.description: Device acting as EAP peer for at least one EAP method supported by AUSF.

entities.name: W-AGF acting on behalf of N5GC device
entities.description: Wireline Access Gateway Function relaying EAP messages between N5GC device and network, handling timers and state transitions.

entities.name: EAP-request message
entities.description: EAP message sent from network to N5GC device via W-AGF.

entities.name: EAP-response message
entities.description: EAP message sent from N5GC device to network via W-AGF.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message
entities.description: NAS message containing EAP-request, ngKSI, and ABBA values.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REJECT message
entities.description: NAS message transporting EAP-failure message in EAP result message transport procedure.

entities.name: Timer T3520
entities.description: Timer started by W-AGF when AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE with EAP-response is sent if N5GC device fails to authenticate network.

entities.name: Timer T3247
entities.description: Timer started by W-AGF upon receiving AUTHENTICATION REJECT with EAP-failure, with random value between 30-60 minutes.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state
entities.description: State entered by W-AGF upon receiving AUTHENTICATION REJECT message.

entities.name: Network authentication failure
entities.description: Condition when N5GC device fails to authenticate the network.

entities.name: N5GC device authentication failure
entities.description: Condition when network fails to authenticate the N5GC device.

relations.description: Procedure requires AUSF to act as EAP server.
Procedure requires N5GC device to act as EAP peer.
Procedure requires W-AGF to relay EAP messages.
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains EAP-request message.
AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message contains EAP-response message.
AUTHENTICATION REJECT message contains EAP-failure message.
Network authentication failure condition starts timer T3520.
Receiving AUTHENTICATION REQUEST with EAP-request stops timer T3520 if running.
Receiving AUTHENTICATION REJECT with EAP-failure starts timer T3247.
Receiving EAP-success message completes the procedure.
Receiving EAP-failure message completes the procedure.
